Sonatina embeds a minimal kernel PortCls helper subset derived from
Microsoft's Windows-driver-samples (audio/sysvad), licensed under the
Microsoft Public License (MS-PL); see LICENSE in this directory.

Retained / minimally adapted SysVAD files:
- NewDelete.h      (from audio/sysvad/EndpointsCommon/NewDelete.h)
- NewDelete.cpp    (from audio/sysvad/EndpointsCommon/NewDelete.cpp;
                    detached from sysvad.h and uses pool tag 'anOS')
- simple.h         (from audio/sysvad/EndpointsCommon/simple.h;
                    pin/node index definitions for 2-pin WaveRT + Topology)
